GRID SECTIONS                                               
─────────────                                               
                                                            
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Two-track grid                                              
                                                            
Ordered first via CSS order:-  First cell sits in the left  
1, so it leads the grid.       track and wraps within its   
                               narrower column at every     
                               width.                       
                                                            
Second cell sits in the right                               
track of the same row.                                      
                                                            
This spanning cell consumes both tracks and fills the whole 
row on its own line.                                        
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
                                                            
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Legacy stack                                                
                                                            
A section with no layout attr stacks its children exactly as
before.                                                     
                                                            
This is the byte-identical parity tripwire.                 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
